title: Spec structured perturber language
description: Design a structured effect/mutation language for game state transitions. Composes movement primitives (move, place, remove, flip, promote, swap, draw, shuffle, transfer, reveal) with control flow (sequence, if/then/else, for_each, choose, repeat, repeat_until_stable). CEL expressions for predicates/filters. repeat_until_stable provides bounded fixpoint iteration with fuel budget for chain reactions (Go captures, Candy Crush cascades, checkers multi-jump). Fuel is a CEL expression evaluated once against initial state. No while, no recursion, no computed gotos. Termination guaranteed by construction. WASM tier only needed for computed scoring and search-dependent predicates.
close_reason: Perturber language: sequence, if/then/else, for_each, repeat(n), repeat_until_stable with fuel budget. Effect primitives delegate to transition engine. Termination guaranteed by construction. 12 tests (6 Rust + 6 Python).
